stories.title: Zverev vince gli Us Open e non se ne accorge, il punto finale e l'esultanza in ritardo

en.title: Zverev wins the US Open but doesn't notice, the final point and celebration come late
en.summary: Zverev won the US Open when his opponent Shelton's serve return went out of bounds, but the German player did not immediately realize his victory until the official score was announced.

stories.title: Attacchi Houthi sull'oleodotto saudita, il petrolio schizza oltre i 108 dollari al barile

en.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi pipeline, oil jumps above 108 dollars per barrel
en.summary: Houthi attacks on a Saudi oil pipeline caused crude prices to rise above 108 dollars per barrel, while Iran-Gulf country talks were postponed and Yemen faced displacement crises.

stories.title: Raid russo sul treno Kiev-Varsavia, Tusk denuncia l'escalation

en.title: Russian raid on Kiev-Warsaw train, Tusk denounces escalation
en.summary: Russian forces attacked trains near the Polish border, halting a convoy carrying Boris Johnson, prompting warnings from Kyiv about Russian aggression and remarks from Trump regarding Ukrainian military operations.

stories.title: Raid russo vicino alla Polonia, paura per diplomatici europei: "nel mirino un treno per Varsavia"

en.title: Russian raid near Poland, concern for European diplomats: a train to Warsaw in the target
en.summary: A Russian attack near Poland raised alarm among European and NATO officials, with Ukraine's Foreign Minister warning of Russian threats and Trump calling for a halt to Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries.

stories.title: Israele, i ministri contro i registi di “Naza”: “Traditori, chiederemo la revoca della cittadinanza”

en.title: Israel, ministers against 'Naza' directors: 'Traitors, we will demand revocation of citizenship'
en.summary: Israeli ministers criticized directors of a documentary that screened at Venice Film Festival, which examines Israeli military tactics used against Gaza civilians. Officials threatened to seek revocation of the filmmakers' citizenship.

stories.title: Raid russo su un treno ai confini della Polonia, Varsavia in allarme

en.title: Russian raid on train at Poland's border, Warsaw on alert
en.summary: Polish Prime Minister Tusk convened national security officials following a Russian military operation near the border. The incident occurred shortly after visits by former UK PM Johnson and US and European security representatives.

stories.title: Meno petrolio saudita dopo gli attacchi scatta l’allarme rincari

en.title: Lower Saudi oil production after attacks triggers price alarm
en.summary: Riyadh's reserves face risk as a Red Sea pipeline remains damaged following attacks. The situation affects approximately 4 percent of global oil supply.

stories.title: Zverev vince gli Us Open, spezzato il sogno di Shelton

en.title: Zverev wins US Open, ending Shelton's dream
en.summary: The Hamburg-based player secured his second Grand Slam title at the US Open, preventing his opponent Shelton from winning the tournament.

stories.title: Ben Gvir contro i registi di Naza premiato a Venezia: “Siete una vergogna, andatevene”

en.title: Ben Gvir attacks Naza film directors awarded at Venice: "You are a disgrace, leave"
en.summary: An Israeli official criticized filmmakers whose work was awarded at the Venice Film Festival, accusing them of defaming military personnel and calling them a dishonor to their nation.

stories.title: Ben Gvir contro i registi di Naza, 'siete una vergogna, andatevene'

en.title: Ben Gvir attacks Naza film directors: "you are a disgrace, leave"
en.summary: An Israeli official criticized filmmakers awarded at Venice Film Festival, suggesting their associates were aligned with Hamas and dismissing their work as dishonorable.

stories.title: Zverev vince gli Us Open, Shelton ko in 4 set. Per il 29enne secondo slam della stagione dopo Parigi

en.title: Zverev wins US Open, Shelton defeated in 4 sets. Second Grand Slam of the season for the 29-year-old after Paris
en.summary: The German player won the men's final at the US Open in four sets, claiming his second major title of the year following his victory at Roland Garros.

stories.title: Raid russo vicino alla Polonia: droni colpiscono un camion e la locomotiva di un treno

en.title: Russian raid near Poland: drones strike truck and train locomotive
en.summary: Russian drone attacks hit infrastructure close to the Polish border, including a truck near a checkpoint and a passenger train locomotive in the Volyn region. Russia claims it targeted facilities used for military cargo transport from Europe.

stories.title: Progetti speciali e nuove giostre, Zamperla punta ai 130 milioni di fatturato

en.title: Special projects and new rides, Zamperla targets 130 million revenue
en.summary: The multinational company celebrates 60 years and introduced a new attraction called Hypnosiz, with ongoing work for Disney and Universal as well as multi-year contracts.
